title: NCAA: Mapua escapes LPU in play-in clash preview
summary: Mapua University escaped Lyceum of the Philippines University, 71-68, to end its group assignments in NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball on a high note on Monday at the PhilSports Arena in Pasig City.
